title: Car insurance policy (2025 Corvane sedan)
text: Policy number MS-448210. Covers the 2025 Corvane C5 sedan. Annual premium is $1,860, paid monthly at $155. Deductible is $500 for collision and $300 for comprehensive. Roadside assistance is included. The policy renews on {date:+36}. To cancel, give 30 days written notice.

title: Dishwasher extended warranty
text: Extended warranty for the Kelvra 300 Series dishwasher, serial KD300-58217. Covers parts and labour for mechanical and electrical failures. Does not cover cosmetic damage or damage from improper installation. Coverage ends {date:+20}. To make a claim, call 1-800-555-0142 with the serial number and proof of purchase.

title: Apartment lease, Unit 304

key_dates.label: Notice to leave or renew due

text: Fixed-term lease for Unit 304 from {date:-100} to {date:+264}. Monthly rent is $1,950, due on the first of each month. Heat and water are included; electricity is not. One small pet is allowed with a $300 pet deposit. Tenant must give three months written notice before the end of the term to leave or renew, by {date:+173}.

title: Internet bill, {month:-15}
text: Fibre 500 plan. Amount due $85.00 by {date:+6}. The promotional rate of $85 per month ends {date:+53}, after which the regular rate is $110 per month. Wi-Fi network name is Unit304-Home.

title: Passport
text: Canadian passport, 10-year validity. Expires {date:+134}. Many countries require at least six months of validity remaining to enter, so travel after {date:-50} may need a renewed passport. Simplified renewal is available if the current passport was issued in the last 15 years.
